description: Gather and organize the house and short-term-rental operational information in HelpingHands, incorporating the saved turnover workflow at docs/rental-turnover-cleaning.md. Jake requests this as an agent task and wants Caleb to have access to the project. Known facts: two rental units, one two-bedroom/one-bath and one one-bedroom/one-bath; small kitchens/bathrooms and lots of glass. Audit existing repo/app storage and authorized available property materials first, avoid inventing house details. Organize useful confirmed information such as unit/room layout, surfaces and cleaning methods, appliances and manuals, linen/consumable inventory and restock levels, trash/laundry workflow, maintenance needs, turnover checklist and checklist verification. Track sources and unknowns; ask concise grouped questions only for missing essentials. Reuse existing HelpingHands UI/data architecture and expose the information usefully rather than dumping unrelated documents. Repo is PUBLIC: do not commit access codes, passwords, private guest/owner data, exact private location details or booking records; use existing private storage where authorized or leave sensitive fields unfilled. Do not publish private source materials into GitHub. Do not message guests/third parties or change bookings. Keep general operational documentation shareable with Caleb. Deliver organized confirmed data/workflow and list unresolved questions; implement modest app integration where supported by existing project design. Default agent lane.

results.identified_issue: Audit: the only property material in the repo was docs/rental-turnover-cleaning.md (162de34) plus the facts in this pebble; no other pebbles, plans or app data mention the rentals. I did not search outside the repo or connected accounts. Integration reuses Plans: Scripts/stage_plans.py bundles every plans/*.md and PlanLibrary lists it, so no Swift change was needed. I git-mv'd the docs file into plans/rental_operations.md to keep one owner instead of two copies; docs/ is now gone. Private data goes nowhere in git: the doc points to the platform or Plans' on-device import (Application Support, never committed). Unknowns are left as literal 'unknown' table cells. I did not invite Caleb to the repo; that is outward-facing and needs his GitHub login. Staged with stage_plans.py into a scratch dir to confirm the title parses; I did not build or check the app on a device.
results.summary: Turned the turnover doc into a rental operations handbook that the Plans screen can read aloud.
results.detailed_description:
I moved docs/rental-turnover-cleaning.md to plans/rental_operations.md and expanded it into one handbook. Plans bundles that folder, so after the next build it shows up in the app's Plans screen and can be read aloud step by step while cleaning. I didn't change any app code.

It has a units table with sources, your 8-step turnover sequence, a new walkthrough checklist to run before leaving, notes on surfaces, a restock table, and sections for laundry, trash, appliances and maintenance. I only found your doc and this pebble as sources, so every unconfirmed detail says "unknown". Nothing private is in it, and it tells people to keep codes and guest details out of the repo.

Caleb can already read it because the repo is public. Tell me his GitHub username if he should be able to edit. The open questions are listed at the bottom of the doc: unit names, adjacency, beds, which machines each unit has, where supplies are stored, how many linen sets each unit keeps, checkout and check-in times, and trash day.

title: Organize house and rental information in Helping Hands
summary: Gather confirmed property details and turn them into useful rental operations and cleaning guidance.
